whatItIs: c2dwave is an open-source project in the annealing and ising category. It is maintained by lanl and primarily looks like a C++ codebase. Translate a subset of C to Verilog

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches annealing and ising workflows in practice. The repository README emphasizes: This program compiles C programs, written using a very small subset of C, to a form suitable for running on a D-Wave quantum annealer by translating through Verilog to D-Wave APIs. The code is still pre-alpha and should therefore be considered unfit for human consumption.
whoItsFor: Developers interested in Ising-model formulations, annealing workflows, and D-Wave-style solver ecosystems.
whatYouCanBuild: See how annealing-oriented projects model optimization problems.
